inherited_input: edition 0.53 model/results/utility_inspection.json human_per_visit; all monetary values remain inherited assumptions

staffing.basis: Two existing contract premises; no probability or empirically estimated avoidability fraction.

field_duty.basis: Presence/absence of separately required physical work; historical operator evidence motivates testing, not its frequency.

fixed_fit.basis: Complete coverage versus one unqualified measurement; source technologies have different properties.

mobile_fit.basis: Qualified complete readings, one failed quality review, or capture after the deadline for review; not a downtime distribution. Late capture is minute61 against cutoff60.

review_capacity.basis: 23 and24 person-minutes bracket the exact twelve-point/two-minute review requirement in the inherited fixture. Not an empirical staffing range.

deadline_minute.basis: 100 and180 minute service windows stress timely fallback; synthetic premises, not proposed utility standards.

customer: site integration, training and qualification not already in bills
asset acquisition/replacement and terminal value not already in fees
applicable software/data rights and renewals not already in fees
tax and financing cash at the actual payer
extra maintenance action, failed review/rework and continuity obligations beyond the modeled window
provider: asset manufacture/replacement and terminal obligation beyond recorded resource bills
unmodeled support, qualification, insurance and financing resources
unbounded_residual_costs.consolidation: Customer/provider fees cancel; do not add a quoted support fee and the resources it purchases to the consolidated total. Specify outside-party boundaries and matched baseline offsets.
unbounded_residual_costs.reason: No joined target lifecycle/resource/cash packet. A zero residual in a displayed window calculation is a boundary, not an estimate of zero full cost.
